text: Thank you for sharing that. To understand the extent of your knee swelling, have you noticed any locking, clicking, or giving way of the joint during movement?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Familial Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (or potentially Familial Osteochondritis Dissecans, given the age and trauma-free onset). Given the strong family history and age, we should confirm if there is any systemic involvement or specific joint stiffness. REQUEST IMAGES: Right_Knee_XRay.
